instructions: On a necessary tool call, optionally add summarize_results to replace bulky results from a solved subproblem with a short factual summary. Keep summary brief, usually 1-3 short sentences: only the selected results' facts, identifiers and source references needed later, not a process recap or copied result bodies. Never exceed 800 characters; select fewer results if their necessary evidence will not fit. Copy their OUTER result_ref into result_refs. Example addition to normal args: {"summarize_results":{"result_refs":[{"turn_id":"<copy>","call_id":"<copy>"}],"summary":"<known facts; next focus>"}}. Use only visible outer refs, including readback pages, never refs from content. Omit summarize_results if full detail is still needed. At most one per response; summary covers knowledge BEFORE this batch. The host replaces worthwhile result bodies at batch close or skips them permanently. Originals remain readable via builtin_history_get_message. No extra call, retry, acknowledgement or final-answer control.
rateExplanation: Verified 2026-10-19. Uniform peak USD/1M: uncached input 0.30, cached input 0.006, all output including reasoning 1.20. Includes follow-up/readback and failed attempts. Cache observed, not controlled; not a billing statement.
